characters.description: A capable, strong-willed Englishwoman who served as a combat nurse during the Second World War and is now on a second honeymoon in the Scottish Highlands in 1945, reconnecting with her historian husband. Practical, blunt, and skilled in medicine, she is used to hardship and unafraid to speak her mind. Her nursing knowledge and level head become vital when she is suddenly cut off from everything familiar.
characters.name: Claire Randall

characters.description: Claire's husband, a gentle Oxford-trained historian recently returned from wartime service. In Inverness he pursues his passion for genealogy, researching his own ancestors in the region. Scholarly and mild-mannered, he is devoted to Claire as the couple try to rebuild their marriage after years apart during the war.
characters.name: Frank Randall

characters.description: A captain of English dragoons in the Scottish Highlands of 1743, and, unsettlingly, a near-perfect likeness of Claire's own husband, whose distant ancestor he is. Cold, cruel, and dangerous, he wields the authority of the occupying English army with sadistic pleasure. From their first meeting he is a menacing figure, and he becomes a persistent threat to Claire and those she comes to care for.
characters.name: Jonathan Randall

characters.description: A dour, weathered Highlander of few words who rides with the clansmen who take Claire in. Gruff on the surface but steadfast and shrewd, he is a loyal kinsman and protector to the younger warrior in the party, and he keeps a watchful, skeptical eye on the strange Englishwoman thrust among them.
characters.name: Murtagh Fraser

characters.description: The war chief of Clan MacKenzie and brother to its laird, a forceful, charismatic, and ambitious man who leads the party that first takes Claire. Bold and politically cunning, he manages the clan's fighting men and its money, and he is deeply invested in Scottish causes. He treats Claire with suspicion, unsure whether she is a spy.
characters.name: Dougal MacKenzie

characters.description: The laird of Clan MacKenzie, who rules from Castle Leoch despite a crippling illness that has twisted his legs and pains him constantly. Sharp, patient, and calculating, he governs through intelligence and diplomacy rather than physical strength, and he weighs carefully what to make of the unexpected Englishwoman brought into his hall.
characters.name: Colum MacKenzie

characters.description: A young Highland warrior of Clan MacKenzie, injured when Claire first tends him. Tall, red-haired, and good-humored, he is brave, honorable, and better educated than his rough life suggests, carrying the scars and the price of an outlaw's past under English persecution. Kind and quick-witted, he becomes Claire's closest companion in a world where she has no one else to trust.
characters.name: Jamie Fraser

characters.description: The warm, bustling, and formidable housekeeper who runs the domestic life of Castle Leoch. Kind-hearted and endlessly capable, she takes Claire under her wing on arrival, providing food, clothing, and a measure of welcome amid the wary strangers of the clan.
characters.name: Mrs. Fitzgibbons

characters.description: A striking, sharp-tongued local woman married to the district's procurator fiscal, known for her deep knowledge of plants and folk remedies. She befriends Claire, sharing an interest in herbs and healing, though there is something knowing and slightly unsettling about her, and whispers of the uncanny cling to her reputation.
characters.name: Geillis Duncan

characters.description: Jamie's fierce, clever elder sister, who has managed the family's Highland estate through hard and dangerous years. Proud, sharp, and devoted to her home and kin, she has weathered great trials with courage and is not easily cowed by anyone, including her long-absent brother when he returns.
characters.name: Jenny Murray
